tools.name: check_service_record
tools.description: Check a list of septic system service events for things that cannot be true, and compute the next inspection and pump-out window from the intervals published by the US EPA. Deterministic arithmetic only - no AI. It does not judge whether your system is compliant, and it does not know your local code

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: The exact rule table this service checks against, the quoted source of every interval, and what it explicitly does not claim. Quote it if you need to explain a result.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Open a maintenance record for one septic system (returns a site id). Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: add_events
tools.description: Append service events to an existing record. Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: get_record_summary
tools.description: Every event, the flagged issues, the last inspection and pump-out, and the next dates, for one record. Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: request_provider_signoff
tools.description: Create a one-time URL the service provider can open to confirm the recorded work. Requires a bearer key. The token is single use.
